purpose: Select and freeze a low-freedom class-independent sibling that can mechanically accept L1/SS and variable 5-9 rider fields without changing Frozen S0 or Frozen N2, using synthetic evidence only.
candidate_freeze_rule: No candidate, coefficient, threshold, seed, world or field-size change after synthetic scoring begins.
comparison_reference: Frozen N2 forecast semantics from the prior synthetic sibling confirmation; N2 is comparison-only and is not changed or promoted.
metrics: candidate mean KL / Frozen N2 mean KL per seed/world/field-size cell

selection_rule.eligibility: candidate must be class-independent, mechanically defined for every field size 5-9, emit finite nonnegative normalized ordered-top3 probabilities, and have ratio_to_N2 <= 1.35 in every preregistered cell
selection_rule.primary: among eligible candidates choose the smallest worst-cell ratio_to_N2
selection_rule.secondary: if worst-cell ratios differ by <=0.005, choose the lower overall mean KL
selection_rule.simplicity_tiebreak: if overall mean KL differs by <=0.5 percent, choose SW0_SCORE_ONLY_PL
selection_rule.no_candidate_rule: if no candidate is eligible, freeze no source-wide sibling and stop without real-PRE rerun

post_selection: If exactly one candidate is selected, freeze its exact interface/coefficient semantics before any real-PRE rerun. The Owner-authorized one-time real-PRE mechanical rerun may then read only race_id plus car_no/class/style/score from the exact same PRE_STRUCTURED v3 hash; class may be audited but the class-independent selected model must not use class in utility generation.
